apps.name: ChopPad
apps.subtitle: Sample, chop and play your songs on pads
apps.localizedDescription: An MPC-style sampler. Pick a song from your music library, chop it into slices, put them on 16 pads across 4 banks, and play them next to a built-in drum kit. Includes a step-accurate sequencer with swing, note repeat, and 16 Levels.

privacy.NSAppleMusicUsageDescription: ChopPad reads songs from your music library so you can sample and chop them.

versions.localizedDescription: New mute group option in pad EDIT: Cut everything. A pad set to it stops every other sound when you hit it.
Version numbers now use x.y.z. New since 1.6: move the playhead in the chop view by sliding along the bottom, and a moving playhead on the waveform in EDIT.
